resources.string: Enter the address you use for iSputnik in a browser.
No iSputnik server answered at that address.
Unable to reach that address. Check it and try again.
That doesn\'t look like an address.
Scan the code with a phone signed in to iSputnik, or open this address on it:
Check that the phone shows this code, then confirm with your password.
This address isn\'t encrypted. Use it only on your own home network.
Devices can only be linked from your home network. An administrator can open a registration window for you.
This server can\'t tell which network devices are on. An administrator needs to set up proxy trust.
The request was refused on the phone. A new code is shown.
Unable to start linking. Trying again…
Press again to unlink. A phone is needed to link them again.
This TV has %1$s. Everyone linked here stays linked, and your place in everything is kept.
Unable to download the update. Check the connection and try again.

This TV has to allow iSputnik TV to install its own updates, once. In the TV\'s settings, turn it on for iSputnik TV. On a Fire TV: My Fire TV, Developer options, Install unknown apps. Then come back and press this again.
